title: Highly porous carbons from hydrochar by means of a controlled physical activation process and their hydrogen storage performance
material_description: CPS-820–55 | CO2-activated carbon from pistachio shells carbonized directly (850 °C, 1 h, N2) and washed with 15% HCl; activated 820 °C 6 h, burn-off 55%
purification_method: 15% HCl 1 day, hot distilled water, dried 120 °C 2 h (after carbonization, before activation)
activation_method: CO2 physical activation 820 °C, 6 h (CO2 230 mL/min after heating under N2 at 5 °C/min); burn-off 55%; BO/t 9.19 wt%/h
source_location: main p4, Table 2, row CPS-820–55 (5 bar, -196 °C column)
notes: Elemental analysis (Table S2, wt%): C 95.57, O 3.78, H 0.46, N 0.19. T printed as -196 °C (77.15 K). Basis total, defined as excess plus gas in the N2 total pore volume. H2 degas in situ 200 °C (ramp 10 °C/min) 4 h; base vacuum <1e-6 mbar (not stated as the degas end pressure, not stored); sample dry mass >20 mg (bound, not stored); H2 grade BIP+ (Air Products), purity not stated numerically. BET by BETSI software, P/P0 range and consistency criteria not stated; Vp single point at P/P0 0.95 (N2), Vmicro from 2D-HS-NLDFT cumulative curve (N2).
basis_evidence: "Net uptake was converted to excess uptake using skeletal (He) densities measured on a Micromeritics Accupyc II. ... Conversion from excess to total uptake was performed using the total pore volume derived from porosimetry (see Section 2.2) [23]. ... All H2 isotherms and reported uptake data are in terms of the total adsorption." (main p3, Section 2.3)
free_volume_calibration: buoyancy correction with skeletal (He) density, Micromeritics AccuPyc II, room temperature

activation_method: CO2 physical activation 855 °C, 19 h (CO2 230 mL/min after heating under N2 at 5 °C/min); burn-off 60%; BO/t 3.17 wt%/h
source_location: main p7, Fig. 4a, series CPS230-855-60 (marker at 91.1 bar)
notes: archive: fig4a_CPS230-855-60.json. Elemental analysis (Table S2, wt%): C 97.36, O 2.20, H 0.31, N 0.13. Markers of this curve below 10 bar overlap markers of other series and could not be separated (see log.md); isotherm_point_count counts the markers at >=10 bar (incl. ones hidden under other series) and is a lower bound. T printed as -196 °C (77.15 K). Basis total, defined as excess plus gas in the N2 total pore volume. H2 degas in situ 200 °C (ramp 10 °C/min) 4 h; base vacuum <1e-6 mbar (not stated as the degas end pressure, not stored); sample dry mass >20 mg (bound, not stored); H2 grade BIP+ (Air Products), purity not stated numerically. BET by BETSI software, P/P0 range and consistency criteria not stated; Vp single point at P/P0 0.95 (N2), Vmicro from 2D-HS-NLDFT cumulative curve (N2).
basis_evidence: "Net uptake was converted to excess uptake using skeletal (He) densities measured on a Micromeritics Accupyc II. ... Conversion from excess to total uptake was performed using the total pore volume derived from porosimetry (see Section 2.2) [23]. ... All H2 isotherms and reported uptake data are in terms of the total adsorption." (main p3, Section 2.3)
free_volume_calibration: buoyancy correction with skeletal (He) density, Micromeritics AccuPyc II, room temperature

activation_method: CO2 physical activation 865 °C, 25 h (CO2 230 mL/min after heating under N2 at 5 °C/min); burn-off 82%; BO/t 3.28 wt%/h
source_location: main p7, Fig. 4a, series CPS230-865-82 (marker at 30.1 bar)
notes: archive: fig4a_CPS230-865-82.json. Elemental analysis (Table S2, wt%): C 97.92, O 1.48, H 0.23, N 0.37. Markers of this curve below 10 bar overlap markers of other series and could not be separated (see log.md); isotherm_point_count counts the markers at >=10 bar (incl. ones hidden under other series) and is a lower bound. T printed as -196 °C (77.15 K). Basis total, defined as excess plus gas in the N2 total pore volume. H2 degas in situ 200 °C (ramp 10 °C/min) 4 h; base vacuum <1e-6 mbar (not stated as the degas end pressure, not stored); sample dry mass >20 mg (bound, not stored); H2 grade BIP+ (Air Products), purity not stated numerically. BET by BETSI software, P/P0 range and consistency criteria not stated; Vp single point at P/P0 0.95 (N2), Vmicro from 2D-HS-NLDFT cumulative curve (N2).
basis_evidence: "Net uptake was converted to excess uptake using skeletal (He) densities measured on a Micromeritics Accupyc II. ... Conversion from excess to total uptake was performed using the total pore volume derived from porosimetry (see Section 2.2) [23]. ... All H2 isotherms and reported uptake data are in terms of the total adsorption." (main p3, Section 2.3)
free_volume_calibration: buoyancy correction with skeletal (He) density, Micromeritics AccuPyc II, room temperature
